You will not regret this purchase! I set it up in my backyard to prevent the basketball from constantly going over the fence and I'm happy to say, mission accomplished!! Not a single ball has went over now with this. Quality is great and you can't beat the price for the size compared to others

I own several holiday rental apartments across Europe, and I have been looking for simple, educational items to add to my apartments for families with children. These VEVOR microscopes have been the perfect addition! They are very easy to use, with clear multilingual instructions that guests from all over Europe can understand. The image quality is excellent, and all the accessories are included, so guests can start using them right away without needing to buy anything extra. The build quality is very solid and durable, they can withstand regular use by guests. The phone holder is very popular with guests, who love taking photos of their observations. They are also very compact and easy to store when not in use. I have now put them in all my rental apartments, and I have received so many positive comments from guests about them!

I manage a co-working space with educational facilities in Brussels, and we needed reliable, easy-to-use microscopes for our workshops and training sessions. These VEVOR microscopes have been absolutely perfect for our needs! They are very easy to use, even for people with no prior experience, and the controls are very intuitive. The optical performance is excellent, the image is sharp and clear even at high magnifications, perfect for educational demonstrations. The build quality is very solid and durable, they can withstand regular use by multiple users. The phone holder is a great addition, allowing us to project the images onto a screen for group viewing. They are also very compact and easy to store when not in use. We have been so impressed with them that we have ordered more for our other locations across the EU!

This VEVOR microscope is perfect for any home or educational use across the European Union, whether you live in a small apartment in Berlin, a spacious house in Madrid, or a traditional home in Rome. It arrived fully assembled and ready to use, with a multilingual manual that is easy to understand for all EU users. The image quality is excellent, you can observe everything from plant cells to microorganisms with crystal clear clarity. The different objectives and eyepieces offer a wide range of magnifications, suitable for all types of observations. It is very easy to use, even for beginners, and the controls are very intuitive. The phone holder is very useful, allowing you to take photos and videos of your observations directly with your smartphone. All the included accessories are high quality and very practical, you have everything you need to start observing right away. It is very stable and well-built, and works perfectly with all EU standard power supplies. I am very happy with this purchase, and I have recommended it to all my friends across Europe!
